highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.2 strengthens native binaries and makes Android native crashes easier to diagnose.
highlights_body: The release also fills gaps in tvOS surface creation APIs without changing the engine milestone.

bullets.detail: Enables Control Flow Guard across Windows native DLLs and buffer security checks for HarfBuzz and ANGLE. Adds Spectre mitigation compiler flags for SkiaSharp native libraries on Windows and Linux.
Adds the missing SKSurface.Create overloads for tvOS.
Preserves and packages Android native symbols to support crash investigation.

contributor_summaries.Aguilex: Control Flow Guard and native buffer security checks.

preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.1.2: Added missing tvOS surface creation overloads and packaged Android native symbols.
preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.2.3: Enabled Windows Control Flow Guard and native buffer security checks.
preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.3.1: Added Spectre mitigation flags for the Windows SkiaSharp native library.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp Windows binaries gain Control Flow Guard and buffer security checks, and Android native symbols are preserved for diagnostics. These are package and native-build changes, not a HarfBuzz engine upgrade.
